title: Inspect and extend: Integrate a safe wallet-demo workflow
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/walletContext.tsx` to demonstrate and safely improve validation-to-plan flow, explicit limitations, test evidence, and release boundary.
problem: Map address input to validation, UTXO planning, and the final refusal boundary. Prepare a demo that shows what would be needed for signing while preventing real-fund expectations. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/walletContext.tsx` and the related project files: src/screens/SendScreen.tsx; src/walletContext.tsx; src/wallet-core.ts; test/wallet.test.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to validation-to-plan flow, explicit limitations, test evidence, and release boundary.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Do not connect real keys or funds to this educational build.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: Map address input to validation, UTXO planning, and the final refusal boundary. Prepare a demo that shows what would be needed for signing while preventing real-fund expectations.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/walletContext.tsx`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
